name: Frostveil Hailcrystal
description: A storm-frozen crystal that keeps a razor chill.
specialEffects: Used in winter axes, freeze-tempered fittings, and cold-forged edgework.

steps: Refine raw stock for Frostveil Hailcrystal under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Frostveil Refinery protocol before storage.
